# Sweep the 13.2 notes' merges since d75cc68543

## Context

The 13.2 notes (`.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md`) were last swept up to `d75cc68543` by #19482 (PR #19484, merged 2026-10-09). Since then `dev` has 37 first-parent merges up to `c09b6c7107`; 8 of them edit the notes themselves. Step 5 of #14800's cut order ([6097885253](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-6097885253)) is the notes re-review, and this is its sweep.

One chapter is now wrong, not only behind. § *Green in emulation, broken by hand* says that a tab torn out and carried over another window parks "clear of the target, in the corner of that display's work area it covers least" (#19374). It also says that "a parked vessel re-shown as the pointer leaves the target now lands under the held pointer" (#19458). #19539 (#19533, ADR 0029 §2.8.6) retired that park for a pointer drag:
- Over another window of the group, that window carries the drag as the source's tab-header proxy, and the riding vessel retires on the claim.
- Leaving for the desktop opens a fresh vessel under the held pointer.
- Only a native title-bar drop still parks behind its target.

#19542 deleted the dormant pointer-path park code. #19556 (Ada, open) makes real Chrome follow the same rule, so the notes describe the rule the release ships. I found this at ~12:56Z and promised the ticket in a lane-claim; this files it.

## The Problem

The notes are the release's public account. They narrate a behavior the release no longer has, and they contradict the docking guide's fourth station, which #19539 already rewrote to explain the close. The merges since the last sweep, among them the B rule itself, the cross-window fixes and four VDOM repairs, are not dispositioned at all.

## The Architectural Reality

- The park sentences: the third bullet under "Each repair moved a measurement off the emulated plane", and the last sentence of the paragraph after it.
- Authority for the rule: ADR 0029 §2.8.6 (`learn/agentos/decisions/0029-docking-design.md`) and #19539's body. The history of the three hand-found defects (size, plane, z-order) stays true and stays.
- Merges to disposition, first-parent `d75cc68543..c09b6c7107`:
  - VDOM: #19483, #19499, #19509, #19525
  - Dock: #19516, #19526, #19529, #19539, #19542, #19551, #19552
  - Workstation: #19532, #19534, #19536, #19546
  - One each: tab #19545, data #19454, SEO #19503, release #19555
  - Plus tests, CI, one dependency group and the three 13.2 blog posts

## The Fix

1. Rewrite the park sentences to the claim-and-retire rule, linking #19539 and #19542, and keep the title-bar park as the native drop's.
2. Disposition every first-parent merge in `d75cc68543..<PR base>` as a chapter line with its PR link, an upgrade row, or the Full Changelog. Each line is written from its PR, never from the subject alone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 No sentence in the notes says a pointer drag parks a vessel; the title-bar park is described as the native drop's.
- [ ] AC-2 Every first-parent merge in the range has a disposition, listed in the PR body.
- [ ] AC-3 The notes' link guard passes, and the Portal renders the changed chapter.

## Out of Scope

#19556's code fix; the FM drop-zone check (cut step 4); the film take (#15252).
